title: MOCS extension beyond N=1023 + section 5.5 independence hardening (statevector, 0 QPU)
methodology: SciMind 4.0 (Anti-Sharpshooter: freeze BEFORE the verdict-bearing measurement)
parent_prereg: pt_rh_multi_observable_v1 (locked 2026-06-17, N in [7, 1023], MOCS = 3, H_MOCS HOLDS)

probe_disclosure.what_ran_before_freeze: A feasibility probe (2026-09-28, scratch session, NOT committed as measurement) measured: (i) dense cv_spread at the 8 v1 points - bit-exact reproduction of the committed v1 values (dev == 0.0 at all 8); (ii) dense and tridiagonal cv at N=65535 (both 0.086356402 to 9 decimals; dense 45.3 s); (iii) cv_spread at all 6 extension points for primes, odd integers and powers of two; (iv) two REJECTED witness designs (S = 0.4*N^0.4: R(7) = 0.63 < 1, no divergence; S = 0.05*N^0.6: R(65535) = 4.4 > 1, no divergence) - corrected to the frozen W1/W2 formulas below BEFORE this freeze.
probe_disclosure.what_the_probe_did_NOT_measure: S_vN at the 6 extension points, alpha over the combined 14-point sweep, R(N) at the extension points, rho_ab, MOCS_ext, the v1 alpha reproduction. All verdict-bearing quantities are UNMEASURED at freeze time.
probe_disclosure.consequence_for_I3: The null leg (I3) was already probed; its outcomes are therefore DOCUMENTED, not predicted. I3 is classified DIAGNOSTIC and is NOT verdict-tragend.

scope.extension_leg: observables (a) alpha_vN, (b) R(N), (c) cv_spread(A) on N_EXT added to the v1 grid -> combined 14-point sweep, v1 thresholds UNCHANGED
scope.independence_leg: I1 divergence witnesses (closed-form, deterministic), I2 rank-dependence rho_ab + effective-observables rule (verdict-bearing), I3 deterministic null controls (diagnostic only)

thresholds_frozen_from_v1_unchanged.alpha_vN: < 0.5, operative value = alpha over the COMBINED 14-point sweep (polyfit(log N, log S), v1 function reused); the v1 8-point alpha is recomputed as a reproduction pin
thresholds_frozen_from_v1_unchanged.R_N: R(N) < 1 for ALL 14 measured N (sub-logarithmic rule, v1 unchanged)
thresholds_frozen_from_v1_unchanged.cv_spread_A: mean over all 14 points in [0.05, 0.20] (v1 band unchanged); per-point values and range reported

verdict_rules.MOCS_ext: count of RH-consistent observables in {a, b, c} on the combined 14-point sweep, in {0,1,2,3}
verdict_rules.per_observable: each observable verdict reported separately; no threshold may be widened post hoc (Prezedenz: KEINE Toleranz-Erhoehung, Phase 11c)

w1.expected_verdicts: a TRUE (alpha < 0.5) AND b FALSE (R(N) > 1 for ALL 14 N); measured R range in probe-equivalent closed form: [1.5710, 9.6117]

w2.expected_verdicts: a FALSE (alpha >= 0.5) AND b TRUE (R(N) < 1 for ALL 14 N); R range [0.0210, 0.5073]

I1_witnesses.claim: both directions of verdict divergence demonstrated on the SAME frozen 14-point N-grid -> (a) and (b) are not logically equivalent in EITHER direction. This hardens section 5.5, which documented one direction only (alpha = 0.6 with negative prefactor -> R < 1).

I2_rank_dependence.metric: Spearman rho between the series {log S_vN(N)} and {log R_N(N)} over the combined 14 points
I2_rank_dependence.effective_rule: effective_ab = 1 + max(0, 1 - |rho_ab|); effective_total = effective_ab + 1 (observable (c) shares no variable with (a)/(b)); H_indep: effective_total >= 2

I3_nulls_diagnostic.status: DIAGNOSTIC, NOT verdict-tragend (probe already ran this leg, see probe_disclosure)
I3_nulls_diagnostic.null_a: odd integers {3, 5, ..., <= N} (uniform density; scipy.linalg.eigh_tridiagonal - dense 32767x32767 would need ~8.6 GB)
I3_nulls_diagnostic.reported: cv_spread per point for primes / null_a / null_b plus deltas and in-band flags
I3_nulls_diagnostic.interpretation_guard: cv_spread measures near-uniformity of the spectrum, NOT primality per se; the nulls quantify exactly what observable (c) does and does not discriminate

solver_pins.primes: dense np.linalg.eigvalsh on the v1-identical Jacobi path (det skipped: overflows, documented in v1 prereg correction_log); v1 8-point cv reproduction must be BIT-EXACT (dev == 0.0)
solver_pins.null_a: scipy.linalg.eigh_tridiagonal (memory); dense-vs-tridiag agreement at N=65535 verified in probe: 0.086356402 both
solver_pins.statevector: pt_prime_state.construct_P_N + measure_entropy, v1-identical path (16 qubits max at N=65535, dim 65536, SVD 256x256)

falsifiable_statements: H_MOCS_EXT: MOCS_ext >= 2 on the combined 14-point sweep with v1 thresholds unchanged
H_WITNESSES: both divergence directions hold (closed-form, verified numerically to alpha_tol = 1e-9)
H_REPRO: v1 8-point observables reproduce within 1e-12 (alpha, S_vN, R) and bit-exact (cv, dense path)
